About TalentBridge

TalentBridge is a leading AI-powered recruitment platform that connects top talent with innovative companies across technology, finance, healthcare, and engineering sectors. Founded in 2019, we have placed over 15,000 candidates globally.

Our Mission
To democratize hiring by making world-class recruitment accessible to companies of all sizes through intelligent automation and human expertise.

Senior Software Engineer
Location: Bangalore, India (Hybrid — 3 days in office)
Department: Engineering
Experience: 5-10 years
Salary Range: ₹25,00,000 — ₹45,00,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build scalable microservices, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to architecture decisions.

Key Responsibilities
- Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices using Python/Go
- Lead code reviews and establish engineering best practices
- Collaborate with product managers to translate requirements into technical solutions
- Optimize system performance and reliability (target 99.9% uptime)
- Mentor junior developers and conduct technical interviews

Required Qualifications
- B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related field (M.Tech preferred)
- 5+ years of experience in backend development
- Strong proficiency in Python, Go, or Java
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Experience with relational and NoSQL databases
- Strong understanding of system design and distributed systems

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with AI/ML systems or data pipelines
- Open-source contributions
- Experience in high-traffic systems (10K+ RPS)

Benefits
- Health insurance for employee and family (spouse + 2 children)
- 24 days paid leave + 12 public holidays
- Annual learning budget of ₹1,00,000
- Stock options (ESOP) after 1 year
- Flexible work hours (core hours 10 AM — 4 Product Manager)
- Gym membership and wellness programs

Application Deadline: 2026-08-31
Apply Now | Share this job

Data Analyst
Location: Bangalore, India (Remote-first)
Department: Data & Analytics
Experience: 2-5 years
Salary Range: ₹12,00,000 — ₹22,00,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
Join our data team to drive insights that power recruitment decisions. You will analyze hiring trends, build dashboards, and support product teams with data-driven recommendations.

Key Responsibilities
- Analyze recruitment funnel metrics and candidate pipeline data
- Build interactive dashboards using Tableau/Power BI/Metabase
- Write complex SQL queries for data extraction and reporting
- Collaborate with product and engineering teams on A/B test analysis
- Develop and maintain ETL pipelines for data warehousing

Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field
- 2+ years of experience in data analysis or business intelligence
- Advanced SQL skills (window functions, CTEs, optimization)
- Proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, matplotlib) or R
- Experience with at least one BI tool (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
- Strong communication skills to present findings to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with dbt or similar data transformation tools
- Knowledge of statistical modeling or machine learning basics
- Experience in HR tech or recruitment analytics

Benefits
- Health insurance for employee and family
- 24 days paid leave + 12 public holidays
- Remote-first with quarterly team meetups
- Annual learning budget of ₹75,000
- Stock options after 1 year

Application Deadline: 2026-09-15

Candidate Screening Process

At TalentBridge, we believe in a thorough yet respectful screening process. Here is what candidates can expect:

Step 1: Initial Voice/Chat Screening (15-20 minutes)
- Verify basic qualifications and experience
- Understand career goals and role fit
- Confirm availability, notice period, and salary expectations
- Answer candidate questions about the role and company
- Result: Qualified / Not Qualified / Need More Information

Step 2: Technical Assessment (45-90 minutes)
- Role-specific assessment tailored to the position
- For engineering roles: coding challenge + system design
- For data roles: SQL + analytics case study
- For product roles: product sense + case study
- For design roles: portfolio review + design challenge
- Assessment is conducted via our online platform or live with an interviewer

Step 3: Cultural Fit Interview (30 minutes)
- Behavioral questions aligned with our core values
- Collaboration and communication assessment
- Growth mindset and adaptability evaluation

Step 4: Hiring Manager Interview (45 minutes)
- Deep dive into relevant experience
- Role-specific scenarios and problem-solving
- Team dynamics and fit assessment

Step 5: Offer and Onboarding
- Competitive offer based on market data and experience
- Negotiation support if needed
- Onboarding starts 1 week before joining date

Timeline: The entire process typically takes 2-3 weeks from initial screening to offer.

Feedback Policy
We provide feedback to all candidates within 5 business days of each stage. If you haven't heard back, please contact your recruiter.

Accommodations
We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. Please inform your recruiter in advance.

Equal Opportunity
TalentBridge is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Frequently Asked Questions

General

Q: What is TalentBridge?
A: TalentBridge is an AI-powered recruitment platform that helps match qualified candidates with the right job opportunities across technology, finance, healthcare, and engineering sectors.

Q: Is TalentBridge a staffing agency?
A: No. TalentBridge is a technology-driven recruitment platform. We are not a staffing agency or temp service. All positions we recruit for are permanent, full-time roles with our client companies or our own organization.

Q: Do I need to pay anything to apply?
A: Absolutely not. TalentBridge never charges candidates any fee. Our services are completely free for job seekers. If anyone asks you to pay for a job application through TalentBridge, it is a scam — please report it immediately.

Q: Where are you hiring?
A: We primarily hire in India (Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad), Philippines (Manila, Cebu), Indonesia (Jakarta, Surabaya), and Singapore. Some roles are fully remote.

Application Process

Q: How do I apply?
A: You can apply through our website, speak with our AI screening assistant, or send your resume to careers@talentbridge.example.com.

Q: What happens after I apply?
A: Within 3-5 business days, you will receive either a screening call/chat invitation or feedback on your application status.

Q: Can I apply for multiple positions?
A: Yes, you can apply for up to 3 positions simultaneously. Our system tracks applications to avoid duplicates.

Q: How long does the hiring process take?
A: Typically 2-3 weeks from initial screening to offer. Some specialized roles may take longer.

Q: What if I need to reschedule my interview?
A: Please contact your recruiter at least 24 hours before the scheduled time. We are flexible and will accommodate reasonable requests.

Compensation & Benefits

Q: What is the salary range for positions?
A: Salary ranges vary by role, experience, and location. Ranges are listed on each job posting. We are transparent about compensation.

Q: Do you offer remote work?
A: It depends on the role. Some positions are remote-first, some are hybrid (typically 3 days in office), and some require full-time in-office presence. Check the specific job listing.

Q: What benefits do you offer?
A: Standard benefits include health insurance (employee + family), 24 days paid leave, 12 public holidays, annual learning budget, stock options (ESOPs), flexible work hours, and wellness programs.

Q: Do you sponsor work visas?
A: Currently, we sponsor work visas for select positions in Singapore. For India, Philippines, and Indonesia, candidates must have existing work authorization.

Technical Assessment

Q: What programming languages are accepted in coding challenges?
A: For most engineering roles, you can use Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++, or Rust. The specific languages accepted are mentioned in the assessment invitation.

Q: Can I use an IDE during the coding challenge?
A: Yes, our online assessment platform provides a full IDE environment. You can also use your local IDE for live coding interviews.

Q: What if I face technical issues during the assessment?
A: Contact our support team immediately at support@talentbridge.example.com. We will reschedule if needed.

Privacy

Q: How is my data handled?
A: Your data is stored securely and used only for recruitment purposes. We comply with GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and local data protection laws. You can request data deletion at any time.

Q: Who can see my application?
A: Only the relevant recruitment team and hiring manager can access your application details.

Candidate Qualification Rules and Scoring

This page outlines the qualification framework used during initial candidate screening.

Qualification Score: Hot / Warm / Cold

Hot Lead (Score: 80-100)
- Meets all required qualifications for the applied role
- Experience within the specified range
- Salary expectations within the posted range (±15%)
- Notice period ≤ 30 days OR immediately available
- Willing to work in the specified location/mode
- Passed initial technical screen questions

Warm Lead (Score: 50-79)
- Meets most required qualifications (≥70%)
- Experience slightly outside range (±1 year)
- Salary expectations within ±25% of range
- Notice period 31-60 days
- Location flexibility needed but open to discussion
- Partial technical screen pass

Cold Lead (Score: 0-49)
- Missing 2+ required qualifications
- Experience significantly outside range (>2 years off)
- Salary expectations >25% above range
- Notice period >60 days with no flexibility
- Unwilling to relocate/commute when required
- Failed initial technical questions

Disqualification Criteria (Automatic Reject)
- Currently employed by a direct competitor (non-compete active)
- Failed background verification in previous application
- Applied more than 3 times in 6 months (cooling period)
- Under 18 years of age
- Requesting compensation >2x the posted range maximum

Notice Period Guidelines
- Immediate to 15 days: Highly preferred
- 16-30 days: Acceptable
- 31-60 days: Acceptable with strong profile
- 61-90 days: Requires hiring manager approval
- 90+ days: Generally not processed unless exceptional candidate

Salary Negotiation Bands
- Within range: Proceed normally
- 1-15% above range: Proceed, flag for recruiter review
- 16-25% above range: Proceed only if Hot lead
- >25% above range: Inform candidate of range, ask if willing to reconsider

Referral Bonus
Employee referrals receive priority screening. Referral bonus: ₹50,000 for standard roles, ₹1,00,000 for senior/leadership roles. Paid after referred candidate completes 90 days.

Our Culture

Core Values
1. Candidate First — Every decision considers the candidate experience
2. Radical Transparency — We share information openly with teams and candidates
3. Continuous Learning — We invest in growth and never stop improving
4. Data-Driven — Decisions backed by evidence, not assumptions
5. Inclusive by Design — Diversity is not an add-on, it's our foundation

Diversity & Inclusion
TalentBridge is committed to building a diverse workforce. Current demographics:
- 48% women in technical roles
- 35% of leadership positions held by underrepresented groups
- Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) for women, LGBTQ+, persons with disabilities
- Unconscious bias training mandatory for all hiring managers

Engineering Culture
- Monorepo with trunk-based development
- CI/CD with automated testing (>85% code coverage)
- Tech stack: Python, Go, TypeScript, React, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes on AWS
- Bi-weekly sprint cycles with Friday demos
- 20% time for innovation projects

Team Events
- Quarterly team offsites
- Monthly game nights and social events

cleaned_content:
CONFIDENTIAL — Internal Recruiter Training Document

Candidate Objection Handling During Screening Calls

Objection 1: "The salary is too low for my experience."
Response Strategy: Acknowledge their expectation. Clarify the total compensation including ESOPs, bonuses (10-25%), learning budget, and benefits. If candidate expects >25% above range, note it and explain the range is based on market data. Do NOT promise salary outside the approved range.

Objection 2: "I don't want to come to office / I want fully remote."
Response Strategy: Explain the current work model for the specific role (hybrid vs remote-first). If the role is hybrid, highlight that it's only 3 days in office with flexible hours. Mention the workcation policy (30 days/year from any city). If candidate insists on fully remote and the role doesn't support it, flag for recruiter review rather than rejecting.

Objection 3: "I have a long notice period (60-90 days)."
Response Strategy: Note the notice period. Explain that for strong candidates, we can work with longer notice periods with hiring manager approval. Ask if they can negotiate with current employer for early release. Never reject solely based on notice period unless >90 days.

Objection 4: "I'm not sure about the company — I haven't heard of TalentBridge."
Response Strategy: Share key facts — 15,000+ placements, offices in 4 countries, backed by reputable investors. Offer to share the company profile document or website links. Emphasize our Glassdoor rating (4.2/5) and employee testimonials.

Objection 5: "I'm interviewing with other companies and have competing offers."
Response Strategy: Acknowledge that it's normal. Ask about their timeline and decision date. Assure them our process is efficient (2-3 weeks). If they have an exploding offer, escalate to hiring manager for fast-tracking.

Objection 6: "I'm not interested in this role, but maybe something else."
Response Strategy: Ask about their preferred role type, seniority, and domain. Check available positions. If a match exists, offer to redirect. If not, ask permission to keep their profile for future openings.

Objection 7: "I have a gap in my employment."
Response Strategy: DO NOT treat gaps as negative. Ask about the reason (caregiving, health, education, travel) only if the candidate offers. Focus on their current skills and readiness. TalentBridge policy explicitly states that career gaps are not a disqualification factor.

Objection 8: "Can I talk to someone who works there first?"
Response Strategy: Offer to connect them with a team member or share employee testimonials. This is a reasonable request — escalate to the recruiter to arrange an informal chat.

Pre-Call Preparation
□ Review candidate resume/profile
□ Note the position they applied for
□ Check for previous applications in system
□ Prepare role-specific qualification questions

Post-Call
□ Update candidate record in ATS

□ Schedule technical assessment if proceeding
□ Share candidate summary with hiring manager

cleaned_content:
Prepare for Your TalentBridge Interview

General Tips
- Research the company and the specific role before your interview
- Prepare specific examples of your past work and achievements
- Be ready to discuss your career goals and why you're interested in TalentBridge
- Have questions prepared to ask the interviewer

For Engineering Candidates
- Practice coding in your preferred language on platforms like LeetCode or HackerRank
- Review system design concepts (load balancing, database sharding, caching)
- Be prepared to discuss trade-offs in your design decisions
- Bring examples of complex systems you've built or contributed to

For Data Roles
- Brush up on SQL (joins, window functions, CTEs)
- Prepare to walk through a data analysis project
- Be ready for case study questions about metrics and KPIs

For Product Roles
- Prepare product sense questions (how would you improve X?)
- Practice estimation and market sizing
- Have examples of products you've shipped and their impact

During the Interview
- Think out loud — we want to understand your thought process
- Ask clarifying questions when needed
- It's okay to say 'I don't know' — we value honesty
- Be yourself — we're evaluating fit, not performance

After the Interview
- You'll receive feedback within 5 business days
- Feel free to follow up with your recruiter if you haven't heard back
- We encourage you to share your interview experience (anonymously) on Glassdoor
